chapter: Sidney Bechet and the Paris festival
title: Who played in Bechet's groups on 52nd Street
summary: Moore lists the pianists and drummers who worked with Bechet and recalls the Boston Buckminster Hotel job.

blocks.x: It was known as the strip for a while, the street, 52nd Street.
Yeah, in Sidney's group, who else was in his group in the late '40s?
Only Sidney and myself, Sammy Price, or Red Richards and Kansas Fields, or Arthur Trappier.

Kansas Fields was a drummer and Arthur Trappier was a drummer. At various times these people were with Sidney, but most of the time, just Sidney and I with a different piano player or different -- I heard this aircheck from the Buckminster Hotel in Boston -- what year was that, 1951 or something -- everything happened so fast. When I think of those years, I'd be with this group here and in two or three weeks I'm with another one or I'd be somewhere else up until 1949
